payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Parts I–IV establish which category governs enforceable numeric discharge limits, monitoring duties, and conditions of non-applicability. The packet contains only the permit cover page, which names the three categories and points to Parts I–IV but does not include any Part I–IV text showing how provisions are classified or whether category boundaries govern exceedance comparison, monitoring applicability, or conditional non-applicability. The packet's known_missing_information notes it may be evidence-insufficient. Without Parts I–IV content or cross-category provisions, neither acceptance (establishing that the listing governs these roles) nor rejection (establishing that it does not) is grounded; unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported closure.
